name: tr-cross-border
description: Turkish cross-border tax for tax year 2026: payments to non-residents and foreign income of Turkish companies. Covers full and limited liability, Turkish-source rules, workplace and permanent representative (PE), withholding on payments to non-resident companies under Corporate Tax Law art. 30 and Decision 2009/14593 (20% on fees, rent and royalties, 15% on dividends and branch remittances, 10% on most loan interest, 0% on foreign bank loans, 30% to listed countries), withholding on non-resident individuals under Income Tax Law art. 94, gross-up when the payer bears the tax, treaty relief and residence certificates, VAT reverse charge on imported services (return no. 2), CFC rules (art. 7), foreign tax credit (art. 33), deadlines and penalties. Trigger on: dar mükellef stopaj, yurt dışı hizmet alımı vergi, KVK 30, mukimlik belgesi, kontrol edilen yabancı kurum, Turkish withholding tax non-resident. Out of scope: treaty-by-treaty rates, transfer pricing (tr-transfer-pricing), corporate
